

# spider.exe is all Rust (spider-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/spider-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# spider.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/spider-rust/src/spider/spider.rs)
# spigame.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/spider-rust/src/spider/spigame.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(spider_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(spider_shims PRIVATE cardlib libadvapi32 libcomctl32 libshell32 libuser32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(spider_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(spider_shims PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(spider spider-cargo spider.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE spider-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS spider_shims psdk)
